Name: Fishing Streak
Author: DrSkyhook
Description:
[heading]Description[/heading]
Catch fish consecutively to build a streak and earn rewards at milestone thresholds.
Fishing Streak adds a lightweight progression system to fishing, with balanced rewards that enhance gameplay without breaking immersion.
[line]
[heading]Customization (Rewards Configuration)[/heading]
All rewards are customizable through:
Mods/FishingStreak/Data/rewards.user.json
You can change:
[list]
[*]Which streaks give rewards (3, 5, 10, etc.)[/*]
[*]The chance to receive a reward[/*]
[*]Category weights (Utility, Materials, Treasure)[/*]
[*]The items that can drop[/*]
[*]Stack sizes and drop frequency[/*]
[/list][line]
[heading]Adding or Editing Rewards[/heading]
Rewards are defined using item IDs.
Example:
[code]{
  "QualifiedItemId": "(O)166",
  "MinStack": 1,
  "MaxStack": 1,
  "Weight": 100
}[/code][list]
[*][b]QualifiedItemId[/b] → the item (e.g.
[code](O)166[/code]= Treasure Chest)[/*]
[*][b]MinStack / MaxStack[/b] → how many you get[/*]
[*][b]Weight[/b] → how common the item is (higher = more likely)[/*]
[/list]Lower weight = rarer drop.
[line]
[heading]Example: Guaranteed Treasure at Streak 3[/heading]
[code]"3": {
  "RewardChancePercent": 100,
  "UtilityWeight": 0,
  "MaterialsWeight": 0,
  "TreasureWeight": 100
}[/code]This makes streak 3 always give a Treasure reward.
[line]
[heading]Mod Compatibility[/heading]
This mod may work with items from other mods, as long as they use valid item IDs.
If a reward does not appear, double-check the item ID.
[line]
[heading]Requirements[/heading]
[list]
[*]SMAPI (latest version)[/*]
[*]No additional mods required[/*]
[/list]
